_help: One file per boat (CLAUDE.md sections F + L, format 2). NO secrets here: no passwords, no keys. The ground station builds its boat list from this folder; the gateway of this boat must have the same name (gateway config "boat"). On connect the HELM station pushes generator_max_pct (the AURIX caps it at 30 %), the relay table and the thruster settings to the AURIX (RAM only). A file without "format" is the old v1 (no relays, generator disabled, no thrusters); a file that fails the checks (groundstation/boats.py) is INVALID and never connected.
name: ER69D
_tailscale_ip_note: PLACEHOLDER: replace with the real Tailscale IP of this boat's gateway PC (e.g. 100.101.102.103); until then the station shows the boat as IP NOT SET
_generator_note: generator_max_pct: the generator's throttle cap in neutral, 0 = disabled; the AURIX caps it at 30 % whatever is written here (TO CONFIRM: 25)
_relays_note: TBD: the Modbus relay board and its channel numbers (WIRING.md, PARTS.md) - confirm n for every relay. type onoff | momentary (board-timed pulse, max_s <= 5) | latching | timed (off after max_s); group engine (IGNITION / STARTER / SHUTOFF: remote restart rules, CLAUDE.md N; every engine relay needs a role: starter | ignition | shutoff - the STARTER is a momentary relay <= 5 s) | trim | extra; pair = the other relay of an interlocked pair (mutual, never both on); show_hud = also on the driving screen; power_up off | on | keep (engine group: only off - never switched automatically).
_thrusters_note: TBD: bow tunnel thruster + stern electric motor (CLAUDE.md P): max_pct = the station's ceiling, run_s / rest_s = the heat budget, jog_m = one JOG step, spot_alarm_m = DP OFF SPOT alarm distance. max_pct 0 = no thruster. TO CONFIRM.
